evals.prompt: make me a gooey toggle switch for pixel-perfect — when you flip it the knob should stretch like liquid across the track and then settle with a spring. motion/react, one self-contained registry-style file (same conventions as registry/new-york/buttons/*.tsx), light + dark. Don't add it to any grid or the registry, just write the component file.
evals.expected_output: A single .tsx file exporting a toggle whose knob visibly stretches (via a goo filter + a lagging ghost shape) while moving, with spring settle, keyboard/aria support, reduced-motion handling, and theme tokens.
expectations: A goo filter (SVG feGaussianBlur followed by an alpha-threshold feColorMatrix, or blur()+contrast()) is applied to an element that contains only shape elements — every text, link, icon or label element is outside the filtered element

The leading shape moves on a spring (type 'spring' / useSpring / animate(..., spring) with stiffness and damping) and a second shape or ghost uses a different, slower timing so the two are visibly apart mid-motion

The two shapes stay within about two blur radii of each other during the motion (a neck or bridge shape, a lag bounded relative to blur, or a screenshot showing the merged blob mid-travel) so the blob does not read as two separate pieces

The filtered element has room for the blur: a stage padded by at least 3× the blur stdDeviation with matching negative margins, or a filter region extended beyond the shapes; and no overflow-hidden on the filtered element or its stage
The filter id is unique per instance (React.useId or equivalent), and the <svg> holding it is rendered (not display:none)
Reduced motion is respected via useReducedMotion or prefers-reduced-motion, and nothing animates on first mount (initial={false} or an equivalent jump)

Shapes inside the filtered element have opaque fills from theme tokens (bg-foreground / bg-primary / bg-background etc., not raw palette colours with dark: overrides); any tint is opacity on the filtered element
'use client' appears before any import; a one-line JSDoc description is present near the top; the component has a default export; imports are limited to react, motion/react and @/lib/utils
The toggle exposes role='switch' with aria-checked (or a native checkbox), toggles on click and keyboard, and has an accessible name (aria-label prop, children, or documented requirement)

evals.prompt: build a segmented nav (Home / Work / About / Contact) for pixel-perfect where the active pill blobs over to whichever item you hover — it should stretch between the old and new item as it travels and settle with a spring, then go back to the selected item when you leave. motion/react, single self-contained file in the registry style. Just write the component, don't wire it into a grid.
evals.expected_output: A single .tsx file exporting a nav whose active indicator is a gooey pill (indicator + lagging clone under a goo filter) that measures item positions, springs to the hovered item, and returns on leave, with reduced-motion handling and theme tokens.
